notes:
Regulated enterprise prospect (capital markets). Interest is Private deployment in customer VPC with Dedicated capacity add-on; data isolation and change-management controls are gating items.

Primary use cases (per Platform Eng + Compliance):
- Internal research assistant over market commentary + internal policy docs (RAG/doc-search)
- Summarize trader chat/email threads for supervision workflows (summarization)
- Draft incident/comms templates during market events (support-agent style)

Key requirements / constraints:
- Deployment: Private in VPC (AWS preferred). No public hosted endpoints for production traffic. Explicit controls for any outbound calls.
- Identity: SSO/SAML required (Okta). RBAC must support “read-only compliance/audit” role.
- Auditability: must log model metadata changes + promotions/rollbacks with actor, timestamp, request id, and affected deployment/region. They specifically asked: “We need to prove to regulators what model was running at time X and who approved the change.”
- Retention: audit logs must be retained >= 13 months (their internal policy); export to SIEM (Splunk) is required. Asked for format details (JSON lines), delivery options (S3 push vs pull API), and whether Private supports the same.
- Change visibility: customer-visible release notes are currently a procurement blocker. They need consistent, human-readable release notes that explain what changed (perf/quality/bugfix/deprecation/security), risk level, and rollback guidance. They do not accept “silent model updates,” even if behavior is “functionally equivalent.”
- Redaction/public vs internal fields: strong concern after hearing about industry incidents where “internal notes” leaked. They asked for explicit guarantees that internal-only fields cannot be rendered in Console and cannot be returned via public API, plus test evidence.
- Version pinning: must be able to pin a model version for critical workflows and opt into promotions via a controlled rollout window.

Procurement feedback (verbatim/paraphrase from 10/02 security review):
- “Release notes aren’t a nice-to-have; we need a change log for models similar to what we require for infra changes.”
- “We will not sign if model changes can happen without a customer-visible record and a rollback path.”

What we shared so far:
- High-level overview of planned unified model metadata schema + automated changelog generation (Console + docs) with public/internal separation.
- Confirmed audit event coverage is in-scope for the rollout tooling project and will be supported for Private/VPC deployments.
